verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفًّۭا

translations.text: By those [angels] lined up in rows
And those who drive [the clouds]
And those who recite the message,
Indeed, your God is One,

verses.text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ
verses.transliteration: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa Rabbul mashaariq

translations.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
verses.transliteration: Innaa zaiyannas samaaa 'ad dunyaa bizeenatinil kawaakib

translations.text: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

verses.transliteration: Wa hifzam min kulli Shaitaanim maarid

translations.text: And as protection against every rebellious devil

verses.text_uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Laa yassamma 'oona ilal mala il a'alaa wa yuqzafoona min kulli jaanib

translations.text: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ ثَاقِبٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Illaa man khatifal khatfata fa atba'ahoo shihaabun saaqib

translations.text: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ
verses.transliteration: Fastaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnaa; innaa khalaqnaahum min teenil laazib

translations.text: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
But you wonder, while they mock,
And when they are reminded, they remember not.

verses.transliteration: Wa izaa ra aw Aayatinw yastaskhiroon

translations.text: And when they see a sign, they ridicule

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa qaalooo in haazaa illaa sihrum mubeen

translations.text: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.

verses.text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.transliteration: 'A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'ainnaa lamab'oosoon

translations.text: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
And our forefathers [as well]?"
Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa innamaa hiya zajra tunw waahidatun fa izaa hum yanzuroon

translations.text: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.

verses.transliteration: Qa qaaloo yaa wailanaa haazaa Yawmud-Deen

translations.text: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."

verses.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Haazaa Yawmul Faslil lazee kuntum bihee tukaziboon

translations.text: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Uhshurul lazeena zalamoo wa azwaajahum wa maa kaanoo ya'budoon

translations.text: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship

verses.text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Min doonil laahi fahdoohum ilaa siraatil Jaheem

translations.text: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
[They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
But they, that Day, are in surrender.
And they will approach one another blaming each other.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

translations.text: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَٰغِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa kaana lanaa 'alaikum min sultaanim bal kuntum qawman taagheen

translations.text: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.

verses.text_uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ

translations.text: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innahum kaanooo izaa qeela lahum laaa ilaaha illal laahu yastakbiroon

translations.text: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa yaqooloona a'innaa lataarikooo aalihatinaa lishaa'irim majnoon

translations.text: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"

verses.transliteration: bal jaaa'a bilhaqqi wa saddaqal mursaleen

translations.text: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon

translations.text: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
But not the chosen servants of Allah.
Those will have a provision determined -
Fruits; and they will be honored
In gardens of pleasure
On thrones facing one another.
There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
White and delicious to the drinkers;

verses.text_uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Laa feehaa ghawlunw wa laa hum 'anhaa yunzafoon

translations.text: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Qaala qaaa'ilum minhum innee kaana lee qareen

translations.text: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

verses.text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
verses.transliteration: 'A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'ainnaa lamadeenoon

translations.text: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"

verses.transliteration: Fattala'a fara aahu fee sawaaa'il Jaheem

translations.text: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa law laa ni'matu Rabbee lakuntu minal muhdareen

translations.text: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
Then, are we not to die

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illa mawtatanal oola wa maa nahnu bimu'azzabeen

translations.text: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
Indeed, this is the great attainment.
For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

verses.text_uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.transliteration: Azaalika khairun nuzulan am shajaratuz Zaqqom

translations.text: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?
Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Innahaa shajaratun takhruju feee aslil Jaheem

translations.text: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa innahum la aakiloona minhaa famaali'oona minhal butoon

translations.text: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًۭا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Summa inna lahum 'alaihaa lashawbam min hameem

translations.text: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.

verses.transliteration: Summa inna marji'ahum la ilal Jaheem

translations.text: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
Indeed they found their fathers astray.
So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.

verses.transliteration: Wa laqad dalla qablahum aksarul awwaleen

translations.text: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
And We had already sent among them warners.
Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
But not the chosen servants of Allah.

verses.transliteration: Wa laqad naadaanaa Noohun falani'mal mujeeboon

translations.text: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.

verses.transliteration: Wa jajainaahu wa ahlahoo minal karbil 'azeem

translations.text: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
"Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
Then We drowned the disbelievers.

verses.transliteration: Wa ina min shee'atihee la Ibraaheem

translations.text: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,

verses.transliteration: Iz jaaa'a Rabbahoo bi qalbin saleem

translations.text: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maazaa ta'budoon

translations.text: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?
Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
And he cast a look at the stars
And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
So they turned away from him, departing.

verses.text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Faraagha ilaaa aalihatihim faqaala alaa taakuloon

translations.text: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
Then the people came toward him, hastening.
He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
While Allah created you and that which you do?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Qaalub noo lahoo bun yaanan fa alqoohu fil jaheem

translations.text: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."

verses.transliteration: Fa araadoo bihee kaidan faja 'alnaahumul asfaleen

translations.text: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.transliteration: Wa qaala innee zaahibun ilaa Rabbee sa yahdeen

translations.text: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falamma balagha ma'a hus sa'ya qaala yaa buniya inneee araa fil manaami anneee azbahuka fanzur maazaa taraa; qaala yaaa abatif 'al maa tu'maru satajidunee in shaaa'allaahu minas saabireen

translations.text: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."
And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
We called to him, "O Abraham,

verses.text_uthmani: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qad saddaqtar ru'yaa; innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen

translations.text: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, this was the clear trial.
And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
"Peace upon Abraham."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

verses.transliteration: Wa bashsharnaahu bi Ishaaqa Nabiyayam minas saaliheen

translations.text: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.

verses.text_uthmani: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌۭ وَظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa baaraknaa 'alaihi wa 'alaaa Ishaaq; wa min zurriyya tihimaa muhsinunw wa zaalimul linafshihee mubeen

translations.text: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.

verses.transliteration: Wa laqad mananna alaa Moosaa wa Haaroon

translations.text: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.

verses.transliteration: Wa najjainaahumaa wa qawmahumaa minal karbil 'azeem

translations.text: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
And We gave them the explicit Scripture,
And We guided them on the straight path.
And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
"Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah?

verses.transliteration: Atad'oona Ba'lanw wa tazaroona ahsanal khaaliqeen

translations.text: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -

verses.transliteration: Allaaha Rabbakum wa Rabba aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

translations.text: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
Except the chosen servants of Allah.
And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
"Peace upon Elias."
Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
[So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].
Then We destroyed the others.
And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
And at night. Then will you not use reason?
And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.

verses.transliteration: Iz abaqa ilal fulkil mash hoon

translations.text: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
And he drew lots and was among the losers.
Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.

verses.transliteration: Falaw laaa annahoo kaana minal musabbiheen

translations.text: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah,

verses.text_uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lalabisa fee batniheee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

translations.text: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa arsalnaahu ilaa mi'ati alfin aw yazeedoon

translations.text: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.

verses.transliteration: Fa aamanoo famatta' naahum ilaa heen

translations.text: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.

verses.transliteration: Fastaftihim ali Rabbikal banaatu wa lahumul banoon

translations.text: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًۭا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am khalaqnal malaaa'i kata inaasanw wa hm shaahidoon

translations.text: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"

verses.transliteration: Alaaa innahum min ifkihim la yaqooloon

translations.text: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
" Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
Has He chosen daughters over sons?
What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
Then will you not be reminded?
Or do you have a clear authority?

verses.transliteration: Faatoo bi Kitaabikum in kuntum saadiqeen

translations.text: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa ja'aloo bainahoo wa bainal jinnati nasabaa; wa laqad 'alimatil jinnatu innahum lamuhdaroon

translations.text: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].
Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].
So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa minnasa illaa lahoo maqaamum ma'loom

translations.text: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah."
And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,

verses.text_uthmani: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.text: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
We would have been the chosen servants of Allah."
But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.

verses.transliteration: Wa laqad sabaqat Kalimatunaa li'ibaadinal mursa leen

translations.text: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
[That] indeed, they would be those given victory
And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
Then for Our punishment are they impatient?

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa izaa nazala bisaahatihim fasaaa'a sabaahul munzareen

translations.text: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
And leave them for a time.
And see, for they are going to see.

verses.text_uthmani: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.text: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
And peace upon the messengers.
And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
